method: SEC Form N-PX structured filings (latest filing per period). Only shareholder proposals. A vote matches a proposal at the same company and meeting (or the same year when the meeting date is not on file) when at least 75% of the title's key words appear in the filing's description, at least 50% the other way, and it beats the next-best proposal at that meeting by 0.15. Anything close but not certain goes to the review list.
not_shown: Praxis files Form N-PX only in the older text format, which this tracker cannot read yet, so it is not shown.
